adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds a refresh-token HTTP call and a `prisma.credential.update` before creating the `jsforce.Connection`:
- It immediately `fetch`es `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` using `credentialKey.refresh_token`, parses it, and then always writes the new token into the credential row (`await prisma.credential.update(...)`) before returning the connection.
There is no conditional/expiry check around this new refresh logic in the added code, so constructing the service will always incur the extra round-trip and DB write. The claimed impacts (extra overhead, potential rate-limit pressure, and concurrent updates to the same credential row) are grounded in this behavior, but it’s primarily a performance/operational concern rather than a direct correctness break shown by the diff.
